name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Tanis Alderwood thanks you for your help and calls you a friend. Danitha Morr sees this small act of service as a way to strengthen the Forsaken’s connection to the Light.

sections.title: A Small Service
sections.body: Danitha Morr says your help may strengthen the Forsaken’s connection to the Light. Mistrust and conspiracies linger among the Dark Lady’s followers. The Forsaken must meet that fear with courage and righteousness. Danitha gives you a symbol for what comes next.

faq.answer: Tanis Alderwood thanks you for helping him and says you will always have a friend in him.

faq.q: What does Danitha say my help means?
faq.answer: Danitha says even a small act of service may strengthen the Forsaken’s connection to the Light.
Danitha says the Dark Lady and some in her service mistrust them, and that some even conspire against them.
A symbol from Danitha, for what comes next.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you hear Danitha describe the Forsaken’s effort to help their people prosper again.
As Forsaken, you hear Danitha call for courage and righteousness in helping your people prosper again.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
